source.name: 腾讯新闻·九五体育 (Tencent News): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商
source.note: Chinese. Translation: 'Shenzhen Peng City FC's chest advertisement is Etihad Airways'. The club announced Etihad as official top partner on 2026-02-10 and retail shirts carry the bilingual chest logo (Sohu Sports, 2026-02-10: '深圳新鹏城最新版的球衣胸前，已经印上了中英文的“阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）”字样', https://sports.sohu.com/a/985885822_120335451 — not script-checkable).
source.quote: 深圳新鹏城足球俱乐部的胸前广告是“阿提哈德航空”

summary: 2026 home kit (Nike, light blue). Front sponsor Etihad Airways, announced as the club's official top partner and official airline on 2026-02-10 and confirmed on the match shirt (Sohu, 2026-02-10; Tencent News, 2026-03-17). Club chairman Tang Xigang told Shenzhen Economic Daily/Dute News on 2026-03-05 that apart from the chest, the sleeve and back positions were still vacant ('除了胸前，包括袖标、背后这些位置都还在虚位以待'). The shorts could not be verified from a source we could open, so sponsorsComplete stays false. The club's 2026 partnership system (Dute News, 2026-03-05) also names, without shirt placements: senior partners Jinjiannan (baijiu), Asahi Beer and Shenzhen New Frontier United Family Hospital, and tier-3/4 partners C'estbon (water), Yundongbao (insurance), Shenzhen Bus Group, TAILG (e-bikes) and Mindray Medical.
